Name: CHAOS_MATCHING_MUTATION_CATEGORY_PARAM_ST
Description: Deep of Night enemy mutation categories. A row is used only while its required modifiers are active in the session.

Fields.Name: Depth 1 Count
Fields.Description: Retail: the number of mutations of this category at depth 1 (26 for Standard Enemy A, 40 for B; 0 for Field and Evergaol bosses). No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Depth 2 Count
Fields.Description: Retail: the number of mutations of this category at depth 2. No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Depth 3 Count
Fields.Description: Retail: the number of mutations of this category at depth 3. No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Depth 4 Count
Fields.Description: Retail: the number of mutations of this category at depth 4 (higher than depths 1–3 for Base Bosses). No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Depth 5 Count
Fields.Description: Retail: the number of mutations of this category at depth 5. No reader was located.
Appears unused by the game. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Category ID
Fields.Description: Mutation category of this row (MUTATION_CATEGORY), matching the Category ID of ChaosMatchingMutationEnemyTableParam rows. Retail: one category per row, repeated per Shifting Earth modifier. No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Required Modifier
Fields.Description: Map-pattern modifier that must be active in the session for this category to be used (with Required Modifier 2, both must be active). 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Required Modifier 2
Fields.Description: Map-pattern modifier that must also be active for this category to be used, together with Required Modifier. 0: no condition. Retail: 0 on every row.
